Black mesh task chairs on five-star bases populate each workstation. Monitors, small potted plants, and desk accessories are visible on the surfaces. Large potted tropical plants — bird of paradise and philodendron — punctuate the space beside structural columns. Dark charcoal commercial carpet tiles cover the floor. The atmosphere is modern, open, and urban-professional.
